title: TriRouter: Sparse-to-Dense Electrode-Space Routing for Robust EEG Motor Imagery Decoding
abstract: arXiv:2610.23665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces require reliable decoding from multichannel EEG, but practical acquisition often yields sparse or corrupted electrode montages. We propose TriRouter, an electrode-space routing framework with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths. A validation-calibrated router uses observable channel availability to allocate path contributions, preserving complete-channel discrimination while increasing representation recovery under severe missingness. In BNCI2014-001, TriRouter outperforms standard public backbones and a dynamic-spatial-filtering corrupted-EEG baseline. It improves accuracy over the strongest corrupted-EEG baseline by 3.68, 4.02, and 6.46 percentage points at nominal 25%, 50%, and 75% missing settings, and remains effective under structured regional missingness and additional low-channel dataset evaluation.

translated_title: TriRouter：面向鲁棒EEG运动想象解码的稀疏到密集电极空间路由
translated_abstract: 运动想象脑机接口需要从多通道EEG（脑电图）中进行可靠解码，但实际采集中常常会产生稀疏或受损的电极导联配置。我们提出TriRouter，这是一种具有判别保持、掩码鲁棒性和潜在补偿三条路径的电极空间路由框架。经过验证校准的路由器利用可观测的通道可用性来分配各路径的贡献，在保持完整通道判别能力的同时，增强严重通道缺失情况下的表征恢复能力。在BNCI2014-001数据集上，TriRouter优于标准的公开骨干网络和基于动态空间滤波的受损EEG基线方法。在标称25%、50%和75%的缺失设置下，相比最强的受损EEG基线，其准确率分别提升3.68、4.02和6.46个百分点，并且在结构化区域缺失场景以及额外的低通道数据集评估中依然保持有效。
tldr: TriRouter提出一种包含判别保持、掩码鲁棒和潜在补偿三条路径的电极空间路由框架，通过验证校准的路由机制在电极严重缺失或受损情况下显著提升EEG运动想象解码的准确率。
en_tdlr: TriRouter introduces an electrode-space routing framework with discriminative-preservation, mask-robustness, and latent-compensation paths, using a validation-calibrated router to achieve significantly more robust EEG motor imagery decoding under severe electrode missingness, improving accuracy by up to 6.46 percentage points over the strongest corrupted-EEG baseline.
